newsitem.title: CZECH REPUBLIC: Ekoagro Slovak branch sold to Dopravni.
newsitem.headline: Ekoagro Slovak branch sold to Dopravni.

text.p: The Slovak branch of the Czech-based Ekoagrobanka a.s. has been sold to Slovakia's Dopravni Banka a.s., Ekoagrobanka's controlling shareholder Czech Union Banka a.s. said in a statement.

Josef Rericha, spokesman for Union Banka which holds a 99.7 percent stake in Ekoagrobanka, said the Slovak branch had been sold in an agreement signed on Wednesday, but he did not disclose any further details of the transaction.
Union Banka a.s. in September closed its Ekoagrobanka branches temporarily to protect deposits soon after the Slovak central bank revoked its operating licence.

Union Banka, which took majority control of Ekoagrobanka after it had been under forced administration of the Czech central bank since January, said then it would appeal against the National Bank of Slovakia's (NBS) move, calling it unjustified.

The Ostrava-based Union Banka bought its stake in Ekoagrobanka from the state-run Czech Konosolidacni Banka which assumed control of Ekoagrobanka when it was put into forced administration in January.
Ekoagrobanka's forced administration officially ended last Friday, Union Banka said.
